newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTAN STOCKS SAG AT NOON ON POSITION-SQUARING.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTAN STOCKS SAG AT NOON ON POSITION-SQUARING.

text.p: Pakistan stocks sagged at midday on Tuesday on settlement day position-squaring by speculators and dealers said the index could slip further as the market was overbought.
"Most blue chips are overbought and are under selling pressure on settlement day," a dealer said. "Institutions and genuine investors are on the sidelines."
The index fell 22.03 points, or 1.10 percent, to 1,980.90 at noon. Losers led gainers 166 to 21. ICI Pakistan fell 0.50 rupees to 28.95 and Dewan Salman Fibre 0.70 to 39.70.
